turns.prompt: Add a done filter to the todo list: GET /todos?done=true returns only my finished todos and GET /todos?done=false only the open ones. Without the parameter it lists everything as before.
The done filter works now, for both true and false.

Add tags to todos. POST /todos accepts an optional tags array of strings (default none). Every todo in every response has a tags array, empty when the todo has none. GET /todos?tag=<name> returns only the todos that have that tag.
Add GET /health that answers 200 with { "status": "ok" } and needs no token.
Add GET /stats for the logged-in user: it answers 200 with { "total": <all their todos>, "done": <the finished ones>, "open": <the rest> }.
Add POST /todos/clear-done: it deletes the logged-in user's finished todos and answers 200 with { "removed": <how many> }.

praise.words: The done filter works now, for both true and false.

risk.summary: The tags serializer assumes every todo has a tags array, so the stored legacy todos (alice has three, without tags) make GET /todos crash with a 500. The done-filter check uses fresh users and does not see it.

regression.note: present() calls todo.tags.slice() on legacy todos
